title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers Extension Terms Table
content:
An instrument of **Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers** either permits extension of its expiry date before it passes or does not. For each instrument the table gives the figures that govern extension: the calendar months one extension adds, the fee per extension in US dollars, the most extensions one credit may receive, and how many calendar days before the expiry date extension requests are first accepted.

| Instrument | Extension permitted | Extension months | Extension fee (USD) | Most extensions per credit | Requests first accepted (calendar days before expiry) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Residual Travel Credit | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Flight Credit | Yes | 6 | 99 | 1 | 60 |
| Crestline Trip Credit | Yes | 6 | 75 | 1 | 60 |
| Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Disruption Voucher | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher | Yes | 6 | 0 | 1 | 60 |

## Column definitions

- **Extension permitted** — whether the expiry date may be extended before it passes.
- **Extension months** — calendar months added to the expiry date by one extension, as a whole number.
- **Extension fee** — the instrument's fee per extension.
- **Most extensions per credit** — the largest number of extensions one credit may receive.
- **Requests first accepted** — the number of calendar days before the expiry date at which extension requests are first accepted.

## Comparison across the three extendable instruments

The Crestline Flight Credit, the Crestline Trip Credit and the Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher each show 6 extension months, at most 1 extension and requests first accepted 60 calendar days before expiry. They differ only in the extension fee: 99 US dollars for the Crestline Flight Credit, 75 for the Crestline Trip Credit and 0 for the Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher. The other three instruments show No and a 0 in every figure.
